output.reason: [ev-0fe6816db4bb] limits this to environments that use the Kafka operand and are upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older. Those environments must have both the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate enabled and StrimziPodSet resources in use. The proposed condition leaves out the Kafka-operand scope, which makes it too broad. It also only checks the feature gate, so it misses environments that are not using StrimziPodSet resources. I rewrote '0.34 or older' as the range <0.35.0.

correction.statement: Environments using the Kafka operand and upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older are exposed if the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate is disabled or StrimziPodSet resources are not in use. They must enable the gate and use StrimziPodSet resources before upgrading.
